name: manual owner SQL eligibility
before: return `(p.id=(SELECT active_attempt FROM slot_policy WHERE id=1) AND (p.phase='manual' OR p.reconcile_attempts>=3 OR ${job.attempts>=3?'1':'0'}=1))`;
after: return `(p.id=(SELECT active_attempt FROM slot_policy WHERE id=1) AND (p.reconcile_attempts>=3 OR ${job.attempts>=3?'1':'0'}=1))`;

name: exhausted publication SQL eligibility
before: return `(p.id=(SELECT active_attempt FROM slot_policy WHERE id=1) AND (p.phase='manual' OR p.reconcile_attempts>=3 OR ${job.attempts>=3?'1':'0'}=1))`;
after: return `(p.id=(SELECT active_attempt FROM slot_policy WHERE id=1) AND (p.phase='manual' OR ${job.attempts>=3?'1':'0'}=1))`;

name: held owner outbox retry admission
before: AND (attempts<3 OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM publication_attempts p WHERE p.target_key=outbox.target_key AND p.id=(SELECT active_attempt FROM slot_policy WHERE id=1)))

name: nonowner exhaustion isolation
before: AND (attempts<3 OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM publication_attempts p WHERE p.target_key=outbox.target_key AND p.id=(SELECT active_attempt FROM slot_policy WHERE id=1)))
after: AND (attempts<3 OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM publication_attempts p WHERE p.target_key=outbox.target_key))
pattern: ^legacy exhausted outbox cannot cross cap without active ownership$
selectedTitle: legacy exhausted outbox cannot cross cap without active ownership

name: strict manual recovery due
pattern: ^strict due remains future even when exhausted outbox is separately due$
selectedTitle: strict due remains future even when exhausted outbox is separately due

name: never evaluate or reconfirm manual owner
selectedTitle: owned success input is negative only {"phase":"manual","expired":false}

name: missing owned run remains scheduled
pattern: ^unavailable evidence keeps manual pointer and durable60 missing$
selectedTitle: unavailable evidence keeps manual pointer and durable60 missing

name: error does not restore null retry deadline
pattern: ^unavailable evidence keeps manual pointer and durable60 error$
selectedTitle: unavailable evidence keeps manual pointer and durable60 error

name: saturated publication attempt history
pattern: ^unavailable evidence keeps manual pointer and durable60 missing$
selectedTitle: unavailable evidence keeps manual pointer and durable60 missing

name: saturated outbox attempt history
pattern: ^unavailable evidence keeps manual pointer and durable60 missing$
selectedTitle: unavailable evidence keeps manual pointer and durable60 missing

name: durable deadline is not restarted
pattern: ^finish keeps the persisted manual deadline rather than restarting60$
selectedTitle: finish keeps the persisted manual deadline rather than restarting60

name: manual owner does not jump rowid progress
before: AND p.phase!='manual' AND (p.phase!='resolved' OR p.id=(SELECT active_attempt FROM slot_policy WHERE id=1))
after: AND (p.phase!='resolved' OR p.id=(SELECT active_attempt FROM slot_policy WHERE id=1))
pattern: ^older due rows progress before repeatedly deferred manual owner$
selectedTitle: older due rows progress before repeatedly deferred manual owner

name: manual send fence blocks claim itself
before: AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM publication_attempts p WHERE p.target_key=outbox.target_key AND p.id=(SELECT active_attempt FROM slot_policy WHERE id=1) AND p.send_until>${DB_NOW})
pattern: ^live send fence dominates recovery cap manual$
selectedTitle: live send fence dominates recovery cap manual

name: manual recurrence must not monopolize global claim
before: ORDER BY CASE WHEN EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM publication_attempts p WHERE p.target_key=outbox.target_key AND ${this.withdrawalPriority()}) THEN 0 ELSE 1 END,
after:
ORDER BY CASE WHEN EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM publication_attempts p WHERE p.target_key=outbox.target_key
        AND p.id=(SELECT active_attempt FROM slot_policy WHERE id=1) AND (p.phase='manual' OR p.reconcile_attempts>=3 OR outbox.attempts>=3))
        OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM publication_attempts p WHERE p.target_key=outbox.target_key AND ${this.withdrawalPriority()}) THEN 0 ELSE 1 END,
pattern: ^a repeatedly missing manual owner must not outrank older due work on every scheduled tick$
selectedTitle: a repeatedly missing manual owner must not outrank older due work on every scheduled tick
